instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and reduce the brightness of the image, then export it as 'character_darker.png'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png in GIMP, reducing brightness (e.g., via Colors > Brightness-Contrast), and exporting as character_darker.png. Verified original brightness is 216.25 using PIL. Evaluator checks if new brightness is at least 20 units lower.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts brightness from the exported image using PIL (converts to grayscale, computes mean brightness)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('original_brightness') and expected.get('min_decrease') without wrapping in 'rules' key
Comparison logic is semantically correct: checks if brightness decreased by at least min_decrease (20 units), which verifies the instruction requirement
Expected values are correct: original_brightness=216.25 was verified using PIL, min_decrease=20 is reasonable (~9% reduction)
Data flow is correct: getter returns float brightness value, metric receives and compares it properly
Evaluator checks the final output state (brightness of exported file), which is sufficient for verifying task completion
Error handling is present in both getter and metric functions
